Hi again. Here's my second offering, following my earlier picture of Wraith (post #452). It's a bit of a hybrid between the original costume and Sentinels Tactics with some additional embellishments and interpretations. Somewhat fittingly, it obviously draws inspiration from 'inspiring presence'.

My girlfriend and I tend to play with a pretty consistent team of Legacy, Wraith, Bunker and Tachyon so I'm working my way through the team with some pictures. Tachyon's up next. Bunker's going to be hard so saving that till last!

Again, hope you like it.
